Changes: removed backgrounds, separated existing artwork into animation layers,
recolored for the interface, and composed two shields for Companion. Animation
and wheel geometry are produced by Walk With Me. No endorsement is implied.

Optional command gestures use the user's installed First Person Interactions
and Offset Movement Animation resources. No third-party HKX animation assets
or framework files are included in this package.
